limitations: Accepted operation semantics do not imply an implemented or supported public transaction writer; embedded capability support fields remain authoritative.
commonRules: Use a price returned by the protocol PriceFeed and current entire system/position state.
Materialize current interest and pending redistribution before evaluating or applying an existing-position change.
Resolve contracts by registry ID and obtain current governed or borrower-specific state at the intended block.
Supply SortedTroves hints derived from current state; stale hints may increase gas or cause an operation to revert.
A quote is not write-safe unless its block, timestamp assumptions, fee-exempt status, and parameter reads are explicit.

records.feeBehavior: Compute feeBase = floor(refinancingFeePercentage * netDebt / 100), then fee = floor(feeBase * borrowingRate / 1e18), unless the borrower is fee exempt. At the recorded values this is 0.02% of net debt before floor rounding.
records.documentationDiscrepancy: Published 0.1% refinance prose is stale for the recorded deployment behavior.
